title: `Core\Html::later` runs a slow part of a page as a child of the request, and a slotted route sends the page before that part is ready
scope:
the method `Core\Html::later`, its placeholder and its per-request token, how a normal route assembles the page, the
route field `slotted` and `Core\Response::slotted()`, the wire format of a slotted response, what a failed slot and a
limit breach show, and when after-response work runs once a response can outlive its frame. The polyfill's own text
and its CSP hashes are named here and may get a record of their own; flushing before the main script ends, a slot in
`<head>` and declarative shadow DOM are not decided here.
validatedBy: the `later` cases under `tests/conformance/core/` and the slotted-delivery tests in `crates/nvs-server/src/serve.rs`, as each stage of goal `html-later` lands them.
